THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
RUNWAY
087
STUDY 125
Pink Floral Top & Embroidered Jeans
Rights check
Source: 25010.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight black hair
blown back by wind stands full-length against a white
backdrop. She wears a pink floral sleeveless top with a
tie waist, a wide gold and cream cameo belt, and a
cream floral shoulder bag. Light-wash flared jeans have
embroidered floral details that run down the legs. Her
expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio light.
Palette of dusty pink, sage, and pale denim. Romantic
and vintage, in the style of a floral runway editorial.
Romantic, vintage, runway
WORKING NOTES
- The floral embroidery and cameo belt are the signature
details.
- Add 'mid-stride' to show the wind-blown hair.
Try this: Try a mid-stride pose with wind-blown hair.
